impact.reason: Controls public attribution and which account performs GitHub writes.

incidents.rationale: Paraphrase: the pilot names historical incident or task reports relevant to this rule. This is reported history, not a reproduced failure or current effectiveness finding.

purpose.text: Paraphrase inferred from current policy: attribution and github identity.

clauses.text: No AI attribution by default: no attribution trailer, co-author line, or footer on commits, PRs, or comments, and harness-injected forms (`Claude-Session:`, a session URL, "Generated with Claude Code") stay out everywhere.
`gh` holds two accounts and the active one is global state, so check `gh auth status` before any `gh` write.
The profile says which `gh` account a checkout uses and what a repository you do not maintain requires before a PR;

revisions.text: - No AI attribution by default: no attribution trailer, co-author line, or footer on commits, PRs, or comments, and harness-injected forms (`Claude-Session:`, a session URL, "Generated with Claude Code") stay out everywhere. The profile says which `gh` account a checkout uses and what a repository you do not maintain requires before a PR; `gh` holds two accounts and the active one is global state, so check `gh auth status` before any `gh` write.
